accordion.note: hairline rules, one accent on the open panel, prose in the page font

alert.note: note badge and two lines, restrained

badge.note: label in a hairline box, accent border used once

breadcrumb.note: mono trail with a truncation ellipsis

calendar.note: month grid, mono, accent on the selected day

card.note: eyebrow, heading, copy, two actions, reads finished

checkbox.note: accent check in a hairline box

collapsible.note: disclosure marker and body, distinct from accordion

combobox.note: labelled field with a chevron, grammar correct

command-palette.note: filter field over a command list with shortcut hints

context-menu.note: closed at rest is the honest default for this pattern

drawer.note: edge panel over a dimmed page, close control present

empty-state.note: glyph mark, line, and one action, does not read as failed to load

field.note: second pass: hairline box in the grammar, error marked with a glyph not colour alone

input-otp.note: second pass: partial code so the default reads as a code field

meter.note: value, figure, and a dithered bar

pagination.note: page run with an accent underline on the current page

preview-card.note: title, description, url, and a source link

progress.note: determinate fill with a dithered remainder

separator.note: hairline with a tracked mono label

radio-group.note: labelled group, filled square marks the selection

scroll-area.note: numbered rows with hairline rules and a scroll indicator

segmented-control.note: second pass: two pixel accent rule under the active segment, no fill, matching tabs

skeleton.note: dithered placeholder blocks rather than a gradient shimmer

slider.note: value, figure, thin track, square handle

spinner.note: small braille indicator, honest at its size

table.note: hairline rules, mono tabular figures, numerics right aligned

textarea.note: hairline box with a character count

toggle-group.note: active item marked by a two pixel accent rule, which is what tabs asks for

diagonal-stripes.note: fine diagonals, quiet enough that a headline over it stays readable

dot-lattice.note: sparse dot field, sits well back from the type

grid-paper.note: minor and major rules, reads as engineering paper

hatch-lines.note: cross hatching with an engraved texture, stays quiet

isometric-grid.note: three axes at thirty degrees, correct isometric construction

truchet-tiles.note: arcs meet at every edge midpoint so paths continue across cells, which is the named failure mode avoided

toast.note: stacked transient messages with close controls and mono labels

toolbar.note: accent rule marks the active item, matching tabs

tree-view.note: box drawing tree with the accent on the current node

brick-lattice.note: running bond courses, quiet under type

cell-mosaic.note: seeded cell mosaic with hairline edges

checkerboard.note: subtle checker that leaves the words clear

moire-rings.note: two ring systems producing a real interference beat

circuit-traces.note: orthogonal routes with vias, the quietest pattern and the most open ground
